response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive full-stack experience (13+ years) across diverse domains, with strong alignment to the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker) and additional expertise in Kotlin/Java. His roles at Optilyz and re:cinq highlight scalable system development, AI-agent infrastructure, and user-focused delivery. While his primary language is TypeScript, his adaptability to multiple languages (including Dlang, Kotlin, Java) and deep understanding of testing (TDD, Vitest) and cloud (AWS) are notable strengths.
strengths: 13+ years of full-stack experience with strong TypeScript/Node.js/React background
Proven track record in scalable systems, AI-agent infrastructure, and user-centric platforms
Deep expertise in testing (TDD, Vitest), cloud (AWS), and polyglot programming (TypeScript, Kotlin, Java, Dlang)
concerns: Limited explicit experience with Nest.js (primary backend framework in the job description)
No direct mention of Vitest in recent roles (though testing expertise is evident)
German language proficiency is only basic, which may impact collaboration in a Berlin-based team

key_factors.factor: AI-agent infrastructure and scalable system contributions
